DiagnosticLevel.description: Payload size for diagnostics (independent of structural `detailLevel`).

oneOf.description: Plus raw traceback / full TD dumps.

OpPath.description: Operator path string passed to TD for resolution via `td.op()`.

Pid.description: OS process id — sole address for tools and queues.

oneOf.description:
Report what loading `target` would mean, and load nothing.

There is deliberately no "do the load" arm. Measured on TouchDesigner
2025.32460: `project.load(path)` returns `None`, so there is nothing to
verify the load against; it destroys the open project; and there is no
`open`, `revert` or `revertProjects` to undo it. `root.load` and
`COMP.load` do not exist either, so a `.tox` cannot be loaded into an
empty operator to make the load non-destructive. A fresh process
(`spawn_td`) is the genuinely fresh load, and the daemon owns it.

SnapshotOverwrite.description: What to do when the destination already exists.

oneOf.description: Refuse. The default, and the only safe one to arrive by accident.

action.description:
What to save, or `status` to report without writing. Defaults to
`project`.

contextPath.description: Optional context path for resolving a relative `path`.

daemonId.description: Optional federated daemon id (omit for local / unique remote resolve).

diagnosticLevel.description: Diagnostic payload size (`summary` omits raw traceback).

overwrite.description: What to do when the destination exists. Defaults to `fail`.

path.description: The COMP to save, for `action: component`.

target.description:
Absolute output path. Required for both saving actions.

Not optional because TouchDesigner's own default is an *incremented*
name under `project.folder` — unpredictable, and therefore impossible
to put in a receipt.
